key.title: Pair the bridge computer
key.description:
Unofficial community project. Not affiliated with Bose Corporation.

Step 1 of 3. Copy this command and run it in a terminal on the bridge computer, in the folder that contains install-bridge.sh. Nothing needs to be typed here.

```
{command}
```

The command installs the bridge and registers this Home Assistant's public key. Use an account that can administer the bridge computer. The public key is not secret. When the command finishes, continue here.

host.title: Bridge computer address
host.description: Step 2 of 3. Enter the address of the bridge computer and the SSH user the installer created. The user defaults to bose, the installer's default. Port 22 is the usual SSH port.

fingerprint.title: Confirm the bridge computer
fingerprint.description:
Step 3 of 3. Home Assistant read this host-key fingerprint from the bridge computer: **{fingerprint}**

The install-bridge.sh command printed its own fingerprint on the bridge computer. Type that printed fingerprint below. Nothing is saved until you submit, and submitting pins the key only if the two match exactly.

error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant can't reach the bridge computer, or it doesn't accept this key yet. Check that the install command finished on the bridge computer and that the bridge is running, then submit again. No command was retried.
error.forced_command_refused: The bridge computer answered in a way the bridge doesn't expect. Check that you ran the full install command exactly as shown, then submit again.
error.invalid_host: Enter the bridge computer's host name or IP address.
error.invalid_user: Enter the SSH user the installer created: lowercase letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.
error.invalid_port: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535.
error.no_host_key: Home Assistant couldn't read the bridge computer's host key. Check the address and that the bridge computer is on with its SSH service running, then submit again.
error.busy: Another learning session is active. Finish or cancel it, or wait five minutes.
error.remote_limit: The bridge supports up to 32 remotes.
error.no_capture: Three matching presses have not been verified.
error.conflict: This code belongs to a different button.
error.no_mapping: This button has no saved code. Learn it before enabling it.

abort.ssh_missing: The ssh program isn't available in this Home Assistant installation, so it can't pair with the bridge computer. See 'Home Assistant without ssh' in the install guide.
abort.ssh_keyscan_missing: The ssh-keyscan program isn't available in this Home Assistant installation, so it can't read the bridge computer's host key. See 'Home Assistant without ssh' in the install guide.
abort.key_unreadable: Home Assistant can't read the saved pairing key. Check the permissions of the .ssh folder in the Home Assistant configuration folder, then start pairing again. Nothing was changed.
abort.config_dir_unwritable: Home Assistant can't write to its configuration folder, so it can't save the pairing key. Check the folder's permissions, then start pairing again.
abort.key_exists: A pairing key exists but Home Assistant couldn't reuse it. Remove the bose_ed25519 file from the .ssh folder in the Home Assistant configuration folder, then start pairing again.
abort.fingerprint_mismatch: The fingerprint you typed doesn't match the bridge computer's host key. Nothing was saved. Start pairing again and compare the fingerprint carefully.
abort.cannot_connect: The bridge is unavailable or returned an invalid response. No command was retried.
abort.unknown_remote: This remote profile is no longer on the bridge computer.
abort.deleted: The remote profile has been deleted.

user.title: Add remote
user.description: You can register an existing remote profile without changing its mappings.

name.title: Name your remote
name.description:
Only Volume up, Volume down, and Mute can be learned. Saved buttons start disabled.

Other remotes you have already set up stop working while you learn this one. They work again when you finish.

prepare.title: {action} — {step} of {steps}
prepare.description:
Other remotes you have already set up stop working while you learn this one. They work again when you finish.

Point {name} at the IR receiver. Select Listen, then press and release this button three times, about one second apart. Held-button repeats do not count. Learning sends no Bose commands.

review.title: Save {name}
review.description:
{mappings}

Saving disables every learned or relearned button. After saving, Configure remote to enable one button at a time, then turn on the remote Enabled switch for physical acceptance.

check.title: Ready to use
check.description:
Other remotes you have already set up stop working while you learn this one. They work again when you finish.

Press each learned button once so the bridge can confirm it. Checking sends no Bose commands. Buttons stay disabled until you enable them in Configure remote.

reconfigure.title: Configure remote
reconfigure.description: Removing only the Home Assistant registration keeps the remote profile on the bridge computer. Delete here to remove it from the bridge computer.

relearn.title: Relearn one button
relearn.description:
Existing mappings remain intact until Save remote.

Other remotes you have already set up stop working while you learn this one. They work again when you finish.

mapping.title: Manage one mapping
mapping.description:
{mappings}

Enable one button at a time and physically test this remote separately. Undecodable or ambiguous signals should remain skipped.

delete.title: Delete remote profile
delete.description: This removes all saved mappings for this remote from the bridge computer. Removing the HA registration alone keeps them.
